purpose: Help compatible clients identify separate JM game lineages and useful bounded recovery queries without copying private bodies, crowns, or raw Library evidence.
resolve: Use Build Mesh status and sync contract at live contact time.
Search exact named body and each explicit branch, never compare bare versions across branches.
Resolve stronger authenticated direct source/receipt/current pointer privately when available; public hints alone are not current authority.
For missing hosted head report SYNC_DRIFT / SNAPSHOT_ONLY / ABSENCE_NOT_PROVEN as appropriate; do not infer absence.
Return PROVEN_FROZEN_ANCHOR, FORWARD_CANDIDATE, CURRENT_AUTHORITY, HOST_PROOF and OWNER_DEVICE separately.
Do not publish raw private Library paths, content, or credentials merely to improve retrieval.
